Name: Positional Audio for Harem Valley (Valley Girls)
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#e69138]~ Harem Valley - Positional Audio ~[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][i]"Heh heh heh... the Valley has never SOUNDED so good."[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]AH, WELCOME, YOUNG ONE![/color][/b][/size]

Sit, sit! Mind the turtle. Now listen closely, because the old master has a secret to share.

You've installed [b]Harem Valley[/b]. The ladies of Pelican Town slip off to their bedrooms, the Saloon bathroom and the forest for some... [i]private training[/i]. But until now it was all silent! What a waste! Even a hermit on a tiny island knows that half the fun is in the [b]listening[/b]. *adjusts sunglasses*

This little add-on uses [b]Positional Audio[/b] so you can [i]hear[/i] those scenes happening around town. The closer you get, the louder it gets. Walk away and it fades out, just like my eyesight when a pretty girl leaves the room.

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]WHAT THIS OLD MASTER HAS PREPARED FOR YOU[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]58 scenes, all wired up.[/b] Every pleasure and sex scene in Harem Valley's schedules for Abigail, Caroline, Emily, Haley, Jodi, Leah, Marnie, Maru, Penny and Robin. Bedrooms, the Saloon bathroom, the toilet stalls, the Forest, the Beach, the hospital, even the Community Center! Nobody escapes old Roshi's ears.[/*]
[*][b]Real distance fading.[/b] The sound comes from her exact spot and fades with distance. You'll know which door to "accidentally" open. Heh heh.[/*]
[*][b]Only plays while it's happening.[/b] It starts when she's actually at her spot doing her thing and stops when she leaves. No moaning on the walk home. This is a [i]refined[/i] mod.[/*]
[*][b]Through the door![/b] Standing outside the Saloon bathroom, or next to the toilet stalls? You'll hear a muffled version through the door. *nosebleed*[/*]
[*][b]Every random variation covered.[/b] Harem Valley picks a different animation each day, and this mod catches them all.[/*]
[*][b]Respects Harem Valley's own settings.[/b] If you switch off a girl's schedule there, her sounds go quiet too. Nothing to set up twice.[/*]
[*][b]Music ducking (optional).[/b] The background music can fade down while you're close, so nothing distracts you from your... studies.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]REQUIREMENTS — EVEN A MASTER NEEDS HIS TOOLS[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9 or newer[/*]
[*][b]Positional Audio[/b] by ichortower (Nexus mod 37134)[/*]
[*][b]Harem Valley[/b], obviously! Without the ladies, this old man is just listening to wind.[/*]
[*][size=2][i](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu, to adjust the settings in-game.[/i][/size][/*]
[/list]
Stardew Valley 1.6 only.

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]BRING YOUR OWN SOUNDS, YOUNG ONE[/color][/b][/size]

The master gives you the dojo; you bring the training equipment. [b]This mod contains no audio files.[/b] Drop your own [b].ogg[/b] files into:

[code][CP] Harem Valley Positional Audio/assets/audio/[/code]
[b]File names:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Generic_Pleasure.ogg[/b] and [b]Generic_Sex.ogg[/b]: used for every girl who doesn't have her own file.[/*]
[*][b]<Name>_Pleasure.ogg[/b] / [b]<Name>_Sex.ogg[/b]: give a girl her own voice, e.g. [b]Abigail_Pleasure.ogg[/b] or [b]Leah_Sex.ogg[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Names:[/b] Abigail, Caroline, Emily, Haley, Jodi, Leah, Marnie, Maru, Penny, Robin

No files? No sound, and no errors spamming your log either. A tidy mod for a tidy hermit.

[spoiler]
[b]The old master's loop-making secrets (for Audacity):[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew plays schedule animations at [b]100 ms per frame[/b]. Harem Valley's main animations loop every [b]500 ms[/b], which is [b]120 BPM[/b], two motions per second.[/*]
[*]Make your loop a whole multiple of 0.5 s: [b]0.5 s[/b] (22,050 samples at 44.1 kHz), [b]1.0 s[/b] (44,100) or [b]2.0 s[/b] (88,200).[/*]
[*][b]2.0 s[/b] also fits the 4-frame variants (400 ms), so one file fits all of them.[/*]
[*]Export as OGG Vorbis at 44,100 Hz. Mono is fine.[/*]
[*]Cut at zero crossings (Z in Audacity) so the loop doesn't click.[/*]
[*]With "Intermittent" playback, short 1–4 second clips work best.[/*]
[/list][i]The tempo will match the animation, but a beat may land a little early or late depending on when you walk in. Even a master can't control everything! Heh heh.[/i][/spoiler]

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]SETTINGS (Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json)[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Characters[/b]: choose whose scenes you can hear. All ten are on by default. The old man doesn't play favourites.[/*]
[*][b]PleasureSounds / SexSounds[/b]: turn each type of scene on or off.[/*]
[*][b]PlaybackStyle[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Loop[/b]: the file plays continuously (uses the game's [i]Ambient[/i] volume slider).[/*]
[*][b]Intermittent[/b]: plays the file, then pauses for a random 1.5–5 seconds (uses the [i]Sound[/i] slider).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Volume[/b]: how loud it is right next to her. Default [b]100[/b].[/*]
[*][b]HearingRange[/b]: how many tiles away it fades to silence. Default [b]12[/b].[/*]
[*][b]MusicDucking[/b]: Off / Light / Medium / Heavy. How much the background music fades when you're close. Default [b]Off[/b].[/*]
[*][b]ThroughDoors[/b]: hear muffled scenes from outside the bathroom and the stalls. Default [b]On[/b].[/*]
[*][b]DoorVolume[/b]: how loud the muffled sound is, as a percentage of Volume. Default [b]10[/b], a whisper through the door, just how the master likes it.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]INSTALLATION[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Positional Audio and Harem Valley.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Put your .ogg files in [b]assets/audio/[/b].[/*]
[*]Start the game. Custom sounds only load at startup, so restart the game whenever you add or rename files.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#e69138]COMPATIBILITY & KNOWN QUIRKS[/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Speedy Solutions:[/b] fully compatible. Each audio file is loaded by exactly one sound, so faster parallel loading can't trip over it.[/*]
[*][b]SVE:[/b] the scenes work, but the "through the door" spot in the Saloon is placed for the vanilla Saloon layout.[/*]
[*][b]Abigail in the bathhouse women's locker room[/b] (summer): a male farmer can't go in there, so you can't hear it. Even the old master has been thrown out of that room. Many times.[/*]
[*]Only the girls' voices play. The fellows (Sebastian, Alex and friends) stay quiet. Who wants to hear [i]them[/i]? Heh heh.[/*]
[*][b]Harem Valley updates:[/b] if Harem Valley changes its schedules, the pack can be regenerated with the Python scripts in the [b]tools[/b] folder (steps in the README).[/*]
[/list]
[line]
